entities.name: Banchō Sarayashiki
entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: Banchō Sarayashiki  is a Japanese ghost story (kaidan) of broken trust and broken promises, leading to a dismal fate. Alternatively referred to as the sarayashiki  tradition, all versions of the tale revolve around a servant, who dies unjustly and returns to haunt the living. Some versions take place in Harima Province  or Banshū (播州), others in the Banchō (番町) area in Edo.
